errors_per_match.reasoning: Gt says 'severe ... presumably collapse', pred says 'likely atelectasis' — pred drops the severity descriptor entirely and downgrades the interpretation from collapse to atelectasis. In an intubated ICU patient, severe LLL collapse triggers bronchoscopy whereas atelectasis is typically observed; clinical management threshold is crossed.

Pred places the tip in the lower SVC, gt places it in the upper right atrium — different anatomic position; atrial tips are conventionally pulled back due to arrhythmia / perforation risk, so the discrepancy changes management.
